content:
The age of the universe is approximately **13.8 billion years**.

More precisely, recent measurements from the Planck space telescope and other observations put it at about 13.787 ± 0.020 billion years. This age is calculated based on observations of the cosmic microwave background radiation, the expansion rate of the universe (Hubble constant), and other cosmological parameters.
